pub fn decode(s: &str) -> String {
    if !s.contains('&') {
        return s.to_string();
    }
    let mut out = String::with_capacity(s.len());
    let mut rest = s;
    while let Some(at) = rest.find('&') {
        out.push_str(&rest[..at]);
        rest = &rest[at..];
        let Some(semi) = rest.bytes().take(12).position(|b| b == b';') else {
            out.push('&');
            rest = &rest[1..];
            continue;
        };
        let entity = &rest[1..semi];
        let ch = match entity {
            "amp" => Some('&'),
            "lt" => Some('<'),
            "gt" => Some('>'),
            "quot" => Some('"'),
            "apos" => Some('\''),
            "nbsp" => Some(' '),
            "mdash" => Some('-'),
            "ndash" => Some('-'),
            "hellip" => Some('…'),
            "deg" => Some('°'),
            "middot" => Some('·'),
            "copy" => Some('©'),
            "rsquo" | "lsquo" => Some('\''),
            "rdquo" | "ldquo" => Some('"'),
            e if e.starts_with("#x") => u32::from_str_radix(&e[2..], 16)
                .ok()
                .and_then(char::from_u32),
            e if e.starts_with('#') => e[1..].parse().ok().and_then(char::from_u32),
            _ => None,
        };
        match ch {
            Some(c) => {
                out.push(c);
                rest = &rest[semi + 1..];
            }
            None => {
                out.push('&');
                rest = &rest[1..];
            }
        }
    }
    out.push_str(rest);
    out
}
